properties.characteristics: A 53-year-old Japanese woman underwent surgery to resect cancer in the cecum. She was treated with capecitabine as postoperative adjuvant therapy, orally administered 2x a day. The patient visited the hospital after developing oral mucositis, and capecitabine treatment was stopped 10 days after initiation. She experienced vomiting, severe diarrhea, and high fever, and was hospitalized and treated with antibiotics and a granulocyte-colony stimulating factor for these conditions, but her general worsened condition rapidly (disseminated intravascular coagulation and loss of consciousness). The patient underwent hemodialysis to remove toxic compounds for 2 days, her condition subsequently improved, and was eventually discharged.
